Signals, Resources, and Signal Forms: Composing Modern Angular End-to-End

About this codelab

Last updated Nov 12, 2026

Written by Babatunde Lamidi

1. Introduction

In this codelab you build the DevFest Lagos Call for Talks app: a small CRUD app where speakers can list, search, create, edit and delete talk proposals.

It is small on purpose. Every line of code you add is one of three ideas:

IdeaAPIJob in this app
Signalssignal, computed, linkedSignalHold state and derive new state from it
ResourceshttpResourceLoad data, with loading and error states built in
Signal Formsform, schema, [formField]Bind inputs, validate them and submit

What you'll do

  • Step 4: Connect to the API with HttpClient.
  • Steps 5 to 7: Build the talks list with httpResource, signal and computed.
  • Steps 8 to 10: Build the talk form with Signal Forms and submit it.
  • Step 11: Reuse the same form to edit a talk with linkedSignal.

What you'll need

  • Node.js 22.22 or newer
  • Git and a code editor
  • A web browser such as Chrome
How this codelab works: you never type code. Each step gives you whole files to paste over the starter files. Use the copy button on each code block, then read the short "What just happened" note that follows.

Open http://localhost:4200. You should see the DevFest Lagos header and an empty Talks page.

Port 3000 already taken? The start script picks the next free port for the API on its own and prints which one it chose. You don't need to change anything.

5. Load talks with httpResource

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-list.ts with the code below.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-list.html with the code below.

What just happened

httpResource is a GET request that behaves like a signal. You give it a function that returns a URL, and it gives you back a set of signals:

SignalMeaning
value()The data. Starts as defaultValue, here []
isLoading()true while the request is in flight
error()The error, if the request failed
hasValue()true once there is data
reload()A method that sends the request again

You didn't subscribe to anything or store anything by hand. The template reads the signals, and Angular updates the page whenever they change.

The URL is a function for a reason. If it read a signal, such as a route id, the resource would send a new request every time that signal changed. You'll use exactly that in step 11.

Check it works

  1. Refresh the app. You see 6 talks.
  2. In Chrome DevTools, open the Network tab and set throttling to Slow 4G. Refresh again and watch the skeleton rows appear while the request loads. Set throttling back to No throttling afterwards.

6. Search and filter with signal and computed

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-list.ts with the code below.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-list.html with the code below.

What just happened

  • query and track are writable signals. The search box calls query.set(...) on every keystroke, and each chip calls track.set(...) when clicked.
  • filtered is a computed signal. It reads talks, query and track, so Angular knows to recalculate it when any of them changes, and only then.
  • The list now loops over filtered() instead of talks.value().

There is no event wiring between the search box and the list. The list depends on filtered, which depends on query, and Angular follows that chain for you.

Check it works

  1. Type flutter in the search box. Only 1 talk is left, and the header reads "1 of 6 talks".
  2. Clear the search and click the AI chip. Only the 2 AI talks are left.
  3. Type something that matches nothing. You see "No talks match your search."

7. Delete with an optimistic update

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-list.ts with the code below.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-list.html with the code below. The only change is the new Delete button next to Edit.

What just happened

delete does three things, in this order:

  1. this.talks.update(...) removes the talk from the resource's value straight away. The list and the count update before the server has even replied. This is called an optimistic update.
  2. this.api.delete(talk.id).subscribe(...) sends the DELETE request.
  3. error: () => this.talks.reload() runs only if the server refuses. The resource fetches the real list again, and the talk comes back.

A resource's value isn't read-only. set and update change it locally until the next request replaces it.

Check it works

  1. Delete a talk. It disappears at once.
  2. Refresh the page. It's still gone, because json-server saved the change to api/db.json.
Want your talks back? Stop the app, run npm run db:reset, then run npm start again.

8. Define the form rules with a schema

Before building the form, you describe what a valid talk looks like. Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-schema.ts with the code below.

What just happened

  • schema<TalkDraft>(...) gives you a typed path to every field: talk.title, talk.duration, and so on. A typo is a compile error.
  • required, min, max, minLength and maxLength are built-in rules. Each one takes a message to show the user.
  • validate is a custom rule. It uses valueOf(talk.level) to read a different field, so this rule depends on two fields. Change the level and the duration error appears or disappears straight away.

The schema has no idea it will be used in a form. That makes it easy to test on its own, which is exactly what talk-schema.spec.ts does.

9. Build the form

First create the component that shows a field's error message. Create src/app/talks/field-error.ts with the code below.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-form.ts with the code below.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-form.html with the code below.

What just happened

  • The model is a plain signal. model holds a TalkDraft, and it is the single source of truth for the form.
  • form(this.model, talkSchema) wraps that signal in a field tree. form.title, form.duration and the rest each point at one part of the model, with your schema's rules attached.
  • [formField]="form.title" binds an input to a field in both directions. Typing updates model, and changing model updates the input. It works the same for text inputs, number inputs, selects and textareas.
  • form.title() (with the parentheses) gives you the field's state: value(), valid(), errors(), touched() and more, all signals. FieldError reads that state and shows the first error once the user has left the field.
  • [formRoot]="form" connects the <form> element to the field tree. It also stops the browser from reloading the page when the form is submitted.

The <pre> at the bottom is temporary. It prints the model so you can watch it change.

Check it works

  1. Click + New talk. Type in the Title box and watch the JSON under the form update with every keystroke.
  2. Click into Speaker, then click somewhere else. "Who is giving this talk?" appears.
  3. Set Level to Advanced and Minutes to 30, then leave the field. "Advanced talks need at least 45 minutes" appears. Change the level to Beginner and it disappears.
  4. Click Create talk. Nothing happens yet. That's the next step.

10. Submit the form

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-form.ts with the code below.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-form.html with the code below.

What just happened

The third argument to form() holds the submission action. When the user submits, Signal Forms:

  1. Marks every field as touched, so all the error messages show.
  2. Stops if the form is invalid. Your action never runs with bad data.
  3. Sets submitting() to true and calls your action.
  4. Waits for the Promise your action returns, then sets submitting() back to false.

What the action returns decides what happens next:

  • undefined means it worked. Here, you've already navigated back to the list.
  • An error object is attached to the form. The template shows it through form().errors().

This is why TalksApi.create returns a Promise: submitting() stays true exactly as long as the request takes.

Check it works

  1. Click Create talk on the empty form. Every error message appears at once.
  2. Fill the form in properly and click Create talk. The button reads "Saving…", then you're back on the list with your new talk at the bottom.
  3. Test a server error: open a new talk form and fill it in. In DevTools, open the Network tab and set throttling to Offline. Click Create talk and "Could not save the talk. Please try again." appears. Set throttling back to No throttling afterwards.

11. Edit a talk with linkedSignal

The /talks/:id route already points at TalkForm. Now teach the form to load an existing talk and save changes to it.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-form.ts with the code below.

Replace the contents of src/app/talks/talk-form.html with the code below.

What just happened

Four pieces fit together:

  1. id = input<string>() receives :id from the URL, thanks to withComponentInputBinding() from step 4. On /talks/new there is no :id, so it stays undefined.
  2. httpResource reads this.id(). When the URL function returns undefined, the resource sends no request at all. So the same component loads a talk when editing and does nothing when creating.
  3. linkedSignal is a writable signal whose starting value comes from other signals. Here the starting value is the loaded talk, or an empty draft. The form can then write to it freely, and if the talk ever reloads, the model resets to the new data.
  4. The submission action calls update when there is an id, and create when there isn't.
Why not use a plain signal for the model? A plain signal is set once, before the talk has loaded. A computed would follow the talk but can't be written to, so the form couldn't change it. linkedSignal is both: it follows its source and accepts writes.

Check it works

  1. Click Edit on any talk. You briefly see the loading skeleton, then the form, filled in with that talk.
  2. Change the title and click Save changes. The list shows the new title.
  3. Open http://localhost:4200/talks/does-not-exist. You see "We couldn't find that talk."
  4. Click + New talk. The form is empty and the button reads Create talk.

12. Congratulations

You built a complete CRUD app with modern Angular, and every piece of state in it is a signal.

What you used

APIWhere
httpResourceLoading the list, and loading one talk by id
signalThe search query and the track filter
computedThe filtered list, and isEdit
linkedSignalThe form model that follows the loaded talk
schema, validateThe form rules, including one that reads two fields
form, [formField], [formRoot]Binding and submitting the form
HttpClientCreating, updating and deleting

What's next

  • Read the Signals guide and the Resource guide on angular.dev.
  • Read the Signal Forms guide.
  • Show a live character count under the abstract, using computed.

  1. Click Edit for any talk. You go see the loading skeleton small, then the form go show, filled with that talk.
  2. Change the title and click Save changes. The list go show the new title.
  3. Open http://localhost:4200/talks/does-not-exist. You go see "We couldn't find that talk."
  4. Click + New talk. The form go dey empty and the button go read Create talk.

12. Congratulations

You don build complete CRUD app with modern Angular, and every piece of state inside am na signal.

Wetin you use

APIWhere
httpResourceTo load the list, and to load one talk by id
signalThe search query and the track filter
computedThe filtered list, and isEdit
linkedSignalThe form model wey dey follow the talk wey load
schema, validateThe form rules, including one wey dey read two fields
form, [formField], [formRoot]To bind and submit the form
HttpClientTo create, update and delete

Wetin next

  • Read the Signals guide and the Resource guide for angular.dev.
  • Read the Signal Forms guide.
  • Show live character count under the abstract, with computed.
  • Add new rule to talkSchema, then write test for am inside talk-schema.spec.ts.

Reset your data

To get the original talks back anytime:

Signals, Resources, and Signal Forms: Composing Modern Angular End-to-End

Nípa codelab yìí

Àtúnṣe tó kẹ́yìn 12 Oṣù Bélú 2026

Olùkọ̀wé: Babatunde Lamidi

1. Ìfihàn

Nínú codelab yìí, ìwọ yóò kọ́ app Call for Talks ti DevFest Lagos: app CRUD kékeré kan níbi tí àwọn olùsọ̀rọ̀ ti lè ṣe àkójọ, wá, ṣẹ̀dá, ṣàtúnṣe, kí wọ́n sì pa àbá ọ̀rọ̀ wọn rẹ́.

A mọ̀ọ́mọ̀ ṣe é ní kékeré. Gbogbo ìlà koodu tí o bá fi kún un jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú èrò mẹ́ta yìí:

ÈròAPIIṣẹ́ rẹ̀ nínú app yìí
Signalssignal, computed, linkedSignalWọ́n ń di state mú, wọ́n sì ń ṣẹ̀dá state tuntun láti inú rẹ̀
ResourceshttpResourceÓ ń gba data, pẹ̀lú ipò loading àti error tí ó ti wà nínú rẹ̀
Signal Formsform, schema, [formField]Ó ń so input pọ̀, ó ń yẹ̀ wọ́n wò, ó sì ń fi wọ́n ránṣẹ́

Ohun tí ìwọ yóò ṣe

  • Ìgbésẹ̀ 4: So mọ́ API pẹ̀lú HttpClient.
  • Ìgbésẹ̀ 5 sí 7: Kọ́ àkójọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú httpResource, signal àti computed.
  • Ìgbésẹ̀ 8 sí 10: Kọ́ fọ́ọ̀mù ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú Signal Forms, kí o sì fi ránṣẹ́.
  • Ìgbésẹ̀ 11: Lo fọ́ọ̀mù kan náà láti ṣàtúnṣe ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú linkedSignal.

Ohun tí ìwọ yóò nílò

  • Node.js 22.22 tàbí èyí tí ó jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ
  • Git àti code editor
  • Browser bíi Chrome
Bí codelab yìí ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́: ìwọ kò ní tẹ koodu rárá. Ìgbésẹ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan yóò fún ọ ní fáìlì pípé láti lẹ̀ mọ́ orí àwọn fáìlì starter. Lo bọ́tìnnì copy lórí bulọ́ọ̀kù koodu kọ̀ọ̀kan, lẹ́yìn náà ka àkọsílẹ̀ kúkúrú "Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀" tí ó tẹ̀lé e.

4. So mọ́ API

Wo API náà

json-server ń fún ọ ní REST API pípé fún array talks tí ó wà nínú api/db.json. Bí npm start ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́, ṣí http://localhost:4200/api/talks nínú browser rẹ. Ìwọ yóò rí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí JSON.

Àwọn endpoint tí app náà ń lò nìyí:

MethodURLOhun tí ó ń ṣe
GET/api/talksṢe àkójọ gbogbo ọ̀rọ̀
GET/api/talks/:idGba ọ̀rọ̀ kan
POST/api/talksṢẹ̀dá ọ̀rọ̀
PUT/api/talks/:idRọ́pò ọ̀rọ̀
DELETE/api/talks/:idPa ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ́

Gbìyànjú http://localhost:4200/api/talks/1 láti rí ọ̀rọ̀ kan ṣoṣo.

Pèsè HttpClient

Àwọn app Angular gbọ́dọ̀ yàn láti lo HttpClient. Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/app.config.ts:

Kọ API service

Iṣẹ́ httpResource ni kíka data, èyí tí ìwọ yóò pàdé ní ìgbésẹ̀ tó kàn. Service yìí ń bójú tó àwọn ìkọ̀wé mẹ́ta. Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talks-api.ts:

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

  • provideHttpClient(withFetch()) mú kí HttpClient wà níbi gbogbo, ó sì sọ fún un pé kí ó lo fetch API ti browser.
  • withComponentInputBinding() ti wà níbẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀. Ó ń fi àwọn route parameter bíi :id ránṣẹ́ tààrà sí component input. Ìwọ yóò lò ó ní ìgbésẹ̀ 11.
  • create àti update fi Promise wé request náà. Signal Forms ń dúró de Promise láti mọ ìgbà tí fífipamọ́ bá parí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìwọ yóò ṣe rí ní ìgbésẹ̀ 10.
  • delete dá request náà padà bí ó ṣe rí. Kò sí ohun tí yóò lọ títí ẹnìkan yóò fi pe .subscribe().

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

Terminal tí npm start ti ń ṣiṣẹ́ kò fi àṣìṣe kankan hàn, app náà sì ṣì ń ṣí. Kò sí ohun tí yóò yí padà lójú-ewé síbẹ̀, nítorí kò sí ohun tí ń pe service náà.

5. Gba àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú httpResource

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-list.ts:

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-list.html:

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

httpResource jẹ́ GET request tí ó ń hùwà bíi signal. O fún un ní function tí ó ń dá URL padà, ó sì fún ọ ní àwọn signal padà:

SignalÌtumọ̀
value()Data náà. Ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí defaultValue, èyí tí ó jẹ́ [] níbí
isLoading()Ó jẹ́ true nígbà tí request ṣì ń lọ
error()Àṣìṣe náà, bí request bá kùnà
hasValue()Ó di true ní kété tí data bá dé
reload()Method tí ó ń fi request ránṣẹ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i

O kò subscribe sí nǹkankan, o kò sì fi ọwọ́ tọ́jú nǹkankan. Template ń ka àwọn signal, Angular yóò sì ṣe àtúnṣe ojú-ewé nígbàkígbà tí wọ́n bá yí padà.

Ìdí wà tí URL fi jẹ́ function. Bí ó bá ka signal kan, bíi route id, resource náà yóò fi request tuntun ránṣẹ́ ní gbogbo ìgbà tí signal yẹn bá yí padà. Ohun tí ìwọ yóò lò gan-an nìyẹn ní ìgbésẹ̀ 11.

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

  1. Tún app náà ṣí. Ìwọ yóò rí ọ̀rọ̀ mẹ́fà.
  2. Nínú Chrome DevTools, ṣí taabu Network, kí o sì ṣètò throttling sí Slow 4G. Tún ṣí lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i, kí o wo àwọn ìlà skeleton bí wọ́n ṣe ń hàn nígbà tí request ń lọ. Lẹ́yìn náà, dá throttling padà sí No throttling.

6. Wá àti ṣàlẹ̀mọ́ pẹ̀lú signal àti computed

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-list.ts:

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-list.html:

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

  • query àti track jẹ́ writable signal. Àpótí ìwádìí ń pe query.set(...) ní gbogbo ìgbà tí o bá tẹ bọ́tìnnì, chip kọ̀ọ̀kan sì ń pe track.set(...) nígbà tí o bá tẹ̀ ẹ́.
  • filtered jẹ́ computed signal. Ó ń ka talks, query àti track, nítorí náà Angular mọ̀ pé kí ó ṣírò rẹ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i nígbà tí èyíkéyìí nínú wọn bá yí padà, àti ìgbà yẹn nìkan.
  • Àkójọ náà ti ń yípo lórí filtered() báyìí dípò talks.value().

Kò sí ìsopọ̀ event kankan láàárín àpótí ìwádìí àti àkójọ náà. Àkójọ gbára lé filtered, filtered gbára lé query, Angular sì ń tẹ̀lé ẹ̀wọ̀n yẹn fún ọ.

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

  1. Tẹ flutter sínú àpótí ìwádìí. Ọ̀rọ̀ kan ṣoṣo ni yóò kù, header yóò sì kà "1 of 6 talks".
  2. Pa ìwádìí rẹ́, kí o sì tẹ chip AI. Ọ̀rọ̀ AI méjì nìkan ni yóò kù.
  3. Tẹ ohun kan tí kò bá nǹkankan mu. Ìwọ yóò rí "No talks match your search."

7. Pa ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ́ pẹ̀lú optimistic update

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-list.ts:

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-list.html. Ìyípadà kan ṣoṣo ni bọ́tìnnì Delete tuntun lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Edit.

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

delete ń ṣe nǹkan mẹ́ta, ní ètò yìí:

  1. this.talks.update(...) yọ ọ̀rọ̀ náà kúrò nínú value resource lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Àkójọ àti iye ọ̀rọ̀ yóò yí padà kí server tó dáhùn. Èyí ni a ń pè ní optimistic update.
  2. this.api.delete(talk.id).subscribe(...) fi request DELETE ránṣẹ́.
  3. error: () => this.talks.reload() ń ṣiṣẹ́ nìkan bí server bá kọ̀. Resource yóò tún gba àkójọ gidi, ọ̀rọ̀ náà yóò sì padà.

Value resource kì í ṣe ohun tí a kò lè yí padà. set àti update ń yí i padà ní ẹ̀gbẹ́ rẹ títí request tó kàn yóò fi rọ́pò rẹ̀.

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

  1. Pa ọ̀rọ̀ kan rẹ́. Yóò pòórá lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.
  2. Tún ojú-ewé ṣí. Ó ṣì ti lọ, nítorí json-server ti fi ìyípadà náà pamọ́ sínú api/db.json.
Ṣé o fẹ́ kí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ padà? Dá app dúró, ṣiṣẹ́ npm run db:reset, lẹ́yìn náà ṣiṣẹ́ npm start lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

8. Kọ òfin fọ́ọ̀mù pẹ̀lú schema

Kí o tó kọ́ fọ́ọ̀mù, ìwọ yóò ṣàpèjúwe bí ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó tọ́ ṣe yẹ kí ó rí. Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-schema.ts:

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

  • schema<TalkDraft>(...) ń fún ọ ní ọ̀nà tí ó ní type sí gbogbo field: talk.title, talk.duration, àti bẹ́ẹ̀ bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ. Àṣìṣe ìkọ̀wé yóò jẹ́ compile error.
  • required, min, max, minLength àti maxLength jẹ́ òfin tí ó ti wà tẹ́lẹ̀. Ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan ń gba ọ̀rọ̀ tí yóò fi han olùlò.
  • validate jẹ́ òfin àdáni. Ó ń lo valueOf(talk.level) láti ka field mìíràn, nítorí náà òfin yìí gbára lé field méjì. Yí level padà, àṣìṣe duration yóò sì hàn tàbí pòórá lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

Schema náà kò mọ̀ pé fọ́ọ̀mù ni yóò lò ó. Èyí mú kí ó rọrùn láti dán an wò fúnra rẹ̀, ohun tí talk-schema.spec.ts sì ń ṣe gan-an nìyẹn.

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

Ṣiṣẹ́ àwọn test lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i:

Gbogbo test márùn-ún yóò yege.

9. Kọ́ fọ́ọ̀mù

Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́, ṣẹ̀dá component tí ó ń fi ọ̀rọ̀ àṣìṣe field hàn. Ṣẹ̀dá src/app/talks/field-error.ts pẹ̀lú koodu yìí:

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-form.ts:

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-form.html:

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

  • Model jẹ́ signal lásán. model ń di TalkDraft mú, òun sì ni orísun òtítọ́ kan ṣoṣo fún fọ́ọ̀mù náà.
  • form(this.model, talkSchema) fi signal yẹn wé inú field tree. form.title, form.duration àti àwọn yòókù ń tọ́ka sí apá kan nínú model, pẹ̀lú àwọn òfin schema rẹ tí a so mọ́ wọn.
  • [formField]="form.title" so input mọ́ field ní ọ̀nà méjèèjì. Títẹ̀ ń ṣe àtúnṣe model, bí model bá sì yí padà, input yóò yí padà. Ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ bákan náà fún text input, number input, select àti textarea.
  • form.title() (pẹ̀lú àkámọ́) ń fún ọ ní state field náà: value(), valid(), errors(), touched() àti àwọn mìíràn, gbogbo wọn jẹ́ signal. FieldError ń ka state yẹn, ó sì ń fi àṣìṣe àkọ́kọ́ hàn ní kété tí olùlò bá kúrò ní field náà.
  • [formRoot]="form" so element <form> mọ́ field tree. Ó tún ń dá browser dúró láti tún ojú-ewé ṣí nígbà tí a bá fi fọ́ọ̀mù ránṣẹ́.

<pre> tí ó wà nísàlẹ̀ jẹ́ fún ìgbà díẹ̀. Ó ń tẹ model jáde kí o lè máa wò ó bí ó ṣe ń yí padà.

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

  1. Tẹ + New talk. Tẹ ọ̀rọ̀ sínú àpótí Title, kí o sì wo JSON tí ó wà lábẹ́ fọ́ọ̀mù bí ó ṣe ń yí padà ní gbogbo ìgbà tí o bá tẹ bọ́tìnnì.
  2. Tẹ inú Speaker, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ ibòmíràn. "Who is giving this talk?" yóò hàn.
  3. Ṣètò Level sí Advanced àti Minutes sí 30, lẹ́yìn náà kúrò ní field náà. "Advanced talks need at least 45 minutes" yóò hàn. Yí level padà sí Beginner, yóò sì pòórá.
  4. Tẹ Create talk. Kò sí ohun tí yóò ṣẹlẹ̀ síbẹ̀. Ìgbésẹ̀ tó kàn ni ìyẹn.

10. Fi fọ́ọ̀mù ránṣẹ́

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-form.ts:

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-form.html:

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

Ohun kẹta tí o fi fún form() ni ó di submission action mú. Nígbà tí olùlò bá fi ránṣẹ́, Signal Forms yóò:

  1. Sàmì sí gbogbo field gẹ́gẹ́ bí èyí tí a ti fọwọ́ kàn, kí gbogbo ọ̀rọ̀ àṣìṣe lè hàn.
  2. Dúró bí fọ́ọ̀mù kò bá tọ́. Action rẹ kì yóò ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú data tí kò dára láé.
  3. Ṣètò submitting() sí true, yóò sì pe action rẹ.
  4. Dúró de Promise tí action rẹ dá padà, lẹ́yìn náà yóò dá submitting() padà sí false.

Ohun tí action náà bá dá padà ló ń pinnu ohun tí yóò ṣẹlẹ̀ tẹ̀lé e:

  • undefined túmọ̀ sí pé ó ṣiṣẹ́. Níbí, o ti gbé olùlò padà sí àkójọ.
  • Error object ni a ó so mọ́ fọ́ọ̀mù. Template ń fi hàn nípasẹ̀ form().errors().

Ìdí nìyí tí TalksApi.create fi ń dá Promise padà: submitting() yóò wà ní true fún gbogbo àkókò tí request bá gbà.

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

  1. Tẹ Create talk lórí fọ́ọ̀mù tí ó ṣófo. Gbogbo ọ̀rọ̀ àṣìṣe yóò hàn lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà.
  2. Kún fọ́ọ̀mù dáadáa, kí o sì tẹ Create talk. Bọ́tìnnì yóò kà "Saving…", lẹ́yìn náà ìwọ yóò padà sí àkójọ pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ tuntun rẹ nísàlẹ̀.
  3. Dán àṣìṣe server wò: ṣí fọ́ọ̀mù ọ̀rọ̀ tuntun, kí o sì kún un. Nínú DevTools, ṣí taabu Network, kí o sì ṣètò throttling sí Offline. Tẹ Create talk, "Could not save the talk. Please try again." yóò sì hàn. Lẹ́yìn náà, dá throttling padà sí No throttling.

11. Ṣàtúnṣe ọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú linkedSignal

Route /talks/:id ti ń tọ́ka sí TalkForm tẹ́lẹ̀. Wàyí o, kọ́ fọ́ọ̀mù bí ó ṣe lè gba ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó ti wà, kí ó sì fi àwọn ìyípadà pamọ́ sí i.

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-form.ts:

Fi koodu yìí rọ́pò gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú src/app/talks/talk-form.html:

Ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀

Apá mẹ́rin ló ṣiṣẹ́ papọ̀:

  1. id = input<string>() ń gba :id láti inú URL, ọpẹ́ ni fún withComponentInputBinding() láti ìgbésẹ̀ 4. Lórí /talks/new, kò sí :id, nítorí náà yóò wà ní undefined.
  2. httpResource ń ka this.id(). Nígbà tí function URL bá dá undefined padà, resource kì yóò fi request kankan ránṣẹ́ rárá. Nítorí náà component kan náà ń gba ọ̀rọ̀ nígbà àtúnṣe, kò sì ṣe nǹkankan nígbà ìṣẹ̀dá.
  3. linkedSignal jẹ́ writable signal tí iye ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ rẹ̀ ń wá láti inú àwọn signal mìíràn. Níbí, iye ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ni ọ̀rọ̀ tí a gbà, tàbí draft tí ó ṣófo. Fọ́ọ̀mù lè kọ sí i bí ó ṣe fẹ́, bí ọ̀rọ̀ náà bá sì tún gbà, model yóò padà sí data tuntun.
  4. Submission action ń pe update nígbà tí id bá wà, àti create nígbà tí kò bá sí.
Kí ló dé tí a kò lo signal lásán fún model? A máa ń ṣètò signal lásán lẹ́ẹ̀kan, kí ọ̀rọ̀ náà tó dé. computed yóò tẹ̀lé ọ̀rọ̀ náà, ṣùgbọ́n a kò lè kọ sí i, nítorí náà fọ́ọ̀mù kò ní lè yí i padà. linkedSignal jẹ́ méjèèjì: ó ń tẹ̀lé orísun rẹ̀, ó sì ń gba ìkọ̀wé.

Yẹ̀ ẹ́ wò pé ó ń ṣiṣẹ́

  1. Tẹ Edit lórí ọ̀rọ̀ èyíkéyìí. Ìwọ yóò rí skeleton loading fún ìṣẹ́jú àáyá díẹ̀, lẹ́yìn náà fọ́ọ̀mù tí a ti kún pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ yẹn.
  2. Yí àkọlé padà, kí o sì tẹ Save changes. Àkójọ yóò fi àkọlé tuntun hàn.
  3. Ṣí http://localhost:4200/talks/does-not-exist. Ìwọ yóò rí "We couldn't find that talk."
  4. Tẹ + New talk. Fọ́ọ̀mù yóò ṣófo, bọ́tìnnì yóò sì kà Create talk.

12. Oríire

O ti kọ́ app CRUD pípé pẹ̀lú Angular òde òní, gbogbo state inú rẹ̀ sì jẹ́ signal.

Ohun tí o lò

APIIbi tí a ti lò ó
httpResourceGbígba àkójọ, àti gbígba ọ̀rọ̀ kan pẹ̀lú id
signalÌwádìí àti àlẹ̀mọ́ track
computedÀkójọ tí a ṣàlẹ̀mọ́, àti isEdit
linkedSignalModel fọ́ọ̀mù tí ó ń tẹ̀lé ọ̀rọ̀ tí a gbà
schema, validateÀwọn òfin fọ́ọ̀mù, pẹ̀lú èyí tí ó ń ka field méjì
form, [formField], [formRoot]Síso àti fífi fọ́ọ̀mù ránṣẹ́
HttpClientṢíṣẹ̀dá, ṣíṣàtúnṣe àti píparẹ́

Kí ló kàn

  • Ka Signals guide àti Resource guide lórí angular.dev.
  • Ka Signal Forms guide.
  • Fi iye lẹ́tà tí ó ń yí padà hàn lábẹ́ abstract, pẹ̀lú computed.
  • Fi òfin tuntun kún talkSchema, lẹ́yìn náà kọ test fún un nínú talk-schema.spec.ts.
